spiritual_reading.full_translation: The love that is active and openly felt in the outer degree performs a sufficient set of operations. First, it consumes and removes what is merely natural and without life, together with whatever is adjoined to that state, so that such things no longer govern. Second, it discriminates and brings into order the mixed contents within that state, setting apart what can be raised into love united with wisdom from what must be cast off into what is rejected, and from what remains only as persuasive appearance without substance. Third, it gives an inward quality and pleasantness to the uses being brought into effect through it, and it also communicates enlivening warmth and gladness to those who are in nearness and conjunction with it. Fourth, it enables those who are in the skills of service to form the containing structures and instruments by which life can act, so that the powers of the mind are fashioned into means for use through that love. Fifth, it makes wisdom outwardly manifest, so that people are able to perceive and discern in the natural degree by means of it.

paragraph_translations.translation: The love that is active and openly felt in the outer degree performs a sufficient set of operations.
paragraph_translations.connection: BEGINS the chapter’s spiritual teaching by stating the subject and its scope.

paragraph_translations.translation: First, it consumes and removes what is merely natural and without life, together with whatever is adjoined to that state, so that such things no longer govern.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the teaching by giving the first operation of active love.
paragraph_translations.notes: The list-item style is simple and translates cleanly.

paragraph_translations.translation: Second, it discriminates and brings into order the mixed contents within that state, setting apart what can be raised into love united with wisdom from what must be cast off into what is rejected, and from what remains only as persuasive appearance without substance.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by describing a second operation: discernment and separation within the natural mind.
paragraph_translations.notes: The fourfold division is slightly forced by the source’s compression, but holds as a separation into elevatable good and truth versus rejected remains and mere appearance.

paragraph_translations.translation: Third, it gives an inward quality and pleasantness to the uses being brought into effect through it, and it also communicates enlivening warmth and gladness to those who are in nearness and conjunction with it.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by moving from purification and discernment to the formation of delightful use and shared vitality.

paragraph_translations.translation: Fourth, it enables those who are in the skills of service to form the containing structures and instruments by which life can act, so that the powers of the mind are fashioned into means for use through that love.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by showing how love empowers orderly making in the degree of works and functions.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Craftsmen” required a functional rendering; the sense is those trained in uses and formation.

paragraph_translations.translation: Fifth, it makes wisdom outwardly manifest, so that people are able to perceive and discern in the natural degree by means of it.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS to the culminating effect: outward illumination for perception and discernment.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strongly coherent: one voice describing five orderly operations of active love in the natural degree—purging, discriminating, qualifying uses, enabling formation of instruments for service, and manifesting wisdom for discernment. The only mild strain is the compressed fourfold separation in ¶3, but it still reads as a consistent internal sorting that supports the chapter’s sequence.

findings.diagnosis: Clean substrate setup: a correspondential teaching framed by function (what fire does), organized as a fivefold sequence. No narrative break, no jurisdictional/authority layer.
findings.evidence: Text: “This fire… it does five works.” The spiritual reading does not stumble here (“BEGINS the chapter’s spiritual teaching… subject and scope”). The chapter’s logic is functional (works/operations), not administrative (no named powers, watches, territories).

findings.diagnosis: Clean functional correspondence: burning/consuming as a first operation. No intrusion, no seam marker, no change of voice.
findings.evidence: Text: “It incinerates and burns wood, and everything that shall be placed upon it.” The spiritual reading notes it “translates cleanly” and treats it as a purgative operation; this is exactly the correspondential mode (effect grounded in what fire does).

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from compression/ellipsis, not an insertion: the fourfold list is under-explained, creating interpretive strain, but it remains within the same functional, physical process (combustion products/manifestations).
findings.evidence: Text: “It separates four aspects of the wood… fire and light, ash and smoke.” The spiritual reading explicitly reports a stumble: “The fourfold division is slightly forced by the source’s compression, but holds….” This is not administrative (no offices, ranks, named beings); it is a terse physical claim that demands unpacking (what exactly is being ‘separated’ and in what order). Removing it would break the chapter’s “five works” structure rather than restore it.

findings.diagnosis: Clean continuation: fire’s imparted qualities (taste/aroma; heat/cheer) provide a natural-functional basis for the spiritual sense. No signs of overlay.
findings.evidence: Text: “It gives a taste and an aroma… also gives heat and cheer….” The spiritual reading reports smooth development “moving from purification and discernment to… shared vitality.” The teaching is still by function (how fire affects food and persons nearby), not by governance.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondence with a slight lexical pressure (‘craftsmen’), but still substrate: artisans using fire to form utensils is a functional image for formation of instruments/structures. No administrative listing or authority language.
findings.evidence: Text: “All craftsmen shall work the utensils… fabricate in it.” The spiritual reading notes only a minor interpretive move (“‘Craftsmen’ required a functional rendering”), not a narrative break. The passage remains grounded in what fire enables (craft/formation).

findings.diagnosis: Clean culmination: fire as light enabling sight. Strong correspondential closure, consistent with the chapter’s progression.
findings.evidence: Text: “It shall display light, and the people see by it.” The spiritual reading treats this as the “culminating effect: outward illumination,” with no stumble. Again, no named administrators or territorial structure—pure function-to-spirit mapping.

textual_criticism.summary: No textual disruptions detected. The chapter is consistently in the correspondential (functional) voice across all paragraphs. The only stumble (¶3) is a genuine difficulty caused by compressed phrasing in the fourfold separation, not evidence of an administrative insertion, overlay block, or seam expansion. Recommendations: none (0 excisions; 0 annotations).

harmonized_paragraphs.text: This fire, which burns and is apparent today in the world, it does five works.
The first work that it does is this: It incinerates and burns wood, and everything that shall be placed upon it.
The second: It separates four aspects of the wood, which are these: fire and light, ash and smoke.
The third: It gives a taste and an aroma to whatever will be cooked on it. It also gives heat and cheer to whoever will be close to it.
The fourth work that it does: All craftsmen shall work the utensils that they will fabricate in it.
The fifth: It shall display light, and the people see by it.

changes_summary: No changes were made. All findings (1–6) recommended none; there were no excisions or annotations to apply.
